name: Partial Differential Equations
description: First order PDEs: classification and examples of PDEs, method of characteristic, complete and general solutions. Second order PDEs in two independent variables: classification, examples and canonical form. Cauchy-Kowalewsky theorem for quasilinear equations, Holmgren’s uniqueness theorem for linear equations. Theory of distribution: test functions and distributions, some operations with distributions, convolution of distributions, fundamental solutions, Schwartz space, tempered distributions. Weak/generalized solution of PDE in divergence form: scalar conservation laws, Rankine-Hugoniot condition, entropy condition, Riemann's problem. Laplace equation: fundamental solution , Poisson's equation, harmonic functions and their properties, maximum principle, Green's function, Dirichlet's principle and method of separation of variables. Heat equation: fundamental solution, mean value theorem and maximum principle, uniqueness results and method of separation of variables. Wave equation: D' Alembert's formula, weak solution, method of separation of variables, method of spherical means (n=2,3), Duhamel`s principle and energy method for uniqueness, the domain of dependence, Range of influence.
